propositions: Data Center backend unit tests only assert shape (dict keys present) and do not pin values, while Cloud's characterization suite pins exact values including priority map, status map, sanitizer boundaries, and label forms

The shared OutboundFieldMapper.map_fields_to_remote is not exercised through WikiTextCodec, so DC-specific composition regressions (dropped length fits, lost guards, mis-mapped branches) reach users undetected
DC's _backend() fixture cannot reach the real probe classifier; FakeTransport.probe_remote hard-codes UNREACHABLE unconditionally, making any pins written through it vacuous assertions of a stub

DC and Cloud have byte-identical DEFAULT_RESOLVED_STATUSES (frozenset({'Resolved', 'Done', 'Cancelled'})), so pins using only default values cannot distinguish between DC's config binding and Cloud's constant, requiring a custom non-default set to prove the distinction

The create-path mapper _map_local_to_dc_fields and sanitizer boundaries must be pinned by exact value per key/limit, including all default-fallback branches (e.g. 'Task', 'Medium', 'To Do') and empty-string coercions

Probe branch classification must be pinned through either direct classify_probe_response calls with DC's resolved statuses or a JiraDataCenterTransport over a stub client, reaching all four branches (PRESENT_RESOLVED, PRESENT_FILTERED, ARCHIVED_OR_MOVED, UNREACHABLE)
